function: Pilot-free full-CSI estimation of a mmWave MIMO channel from camera image, LiDAR point cloud and GPS by conditional flow matching (pp. 1, 3-8).
system: mmWave MIMO: BS 64 antennas, 4 RF chains; one user 16 antennas, 4 RF chains; hybrid arrays; 120 kHz bandwidth; carrier not stated; no RIS (pp. 3, 10).
method: Supervised conditional flow matching: CNN, PointNet, MLP encoder with attention fusion, U-Net velocity field, contrastive alignment loss; 2000 epochs; 7-step ODE inference (pp. 6-8, 10, 12).
data_channel: Sionna (3GPP-compliant, ray-tracing model) channels and Blender sensing data, urban intersection with four buildings, four vehicles; 6,000 user locations, 5 frames each, 30,000 samples (pp. 10-11).
test_conditions: Site-specific: 9:1 train-test split of the same simulated intersection dataset; tests sweep SNR, acquisition period and sensing noise; unseen environments not tested (pp. 4, 10, 14-16).
baselines: Non-learned: LS, LASSO, KNN location-based inference; learned: DDPM and DDIM diffusion estimators, Transformer multimodal beam selection (SE task); ablations CFM, CFM+Recon, encoder-only (pp. 10-13).
metrics: NMSE, cosine similarity, achievable spectral efficiency of hybrid beamforming as downstream task, and inference latency (pp. 11-15).
complexity: Big-O complexity of encoder and U-Net (Eqs. 31-41); inference latency about 1.25 ms for K=2, below 2.5 ms for K=7; model sizes 209.43 and 142.59 MB (pp. 8-10, 12).
openness: Source code at https://github.com/gm-leung/environmentaware-channel-inference (p. 1); release of the generated dataset is not stated.
q1_support: p. 10: "3GPP-compliant MIMO channels and multimodal sensing data". Sionna generates the channels with a ray-tracing model in a custom Blender scene (p. 11); no TR number is given, so the reviewer should confirm this counts.
q2_support: p. 4: "site-specific training and evaluation". The paper says zero-shot generalization to unseen environments is not addressed, and its tests sweep SNR, Tca and sensing noise on a 9:1 split of one dataset (p. 10), so not met.
q3_support: p. 10: "DDPM-Based Channel Estimation [11]" and DDIM [12] are earlier learned estimators, with LS and LASSO as non-learned baselines; the proposed method has the lowest NMSE and highest cosine similarity (p. 14).
q4_support: p. 12: "about 1.25 ms for K = 2 and remains below 2.5 ms for K = 7". Big-O complexity of the encoder and U-Net is also given in Eqs. (31)-(41) on pp. 8-10.
q5_support: p. 1: "The source code is available at" a GitHub link given on the first page.
notes: Area 2: the learned model estimates the full CSI from sensing data, and beamforming spectral efficiency is only a downstream evaluation (pp. 14-15), so the main metric is NMSE. q1 is borderline and left for the reviewer: the channels come from Sionna ray tracing in a custom scene, described as 3GPP-compliant without naming TR 38.901. The generated dataset is not stated as released, so q5 rests on the code link.
